issues.detail: The Greek 'επι ταις ταλαιπωριαις υμων' (upon your tribulations) indicates that the tribulations belong to the rich people ('υμων'). The Vietnamese translation 'trên các ngươi' (on you/upon you) shifts the focus to the location of the tribulations rather than their ownership/subject, and the Greek implies the tribulations are happening *to* them as their own specific plight.
